API-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-CLIENT.content: {"interface_id": "API-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-CLIENT", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "API", "name": "Frontend auth session API client", "file_path": "frontend/src/api/authSession.ts", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reuse typed frontend calls for local password login, current-session recovery, and logout through the shared Axios client and same-origin /api path.", "specification": "Exports AuthRole, AuthenticatedUser, LoginRequest, SessionResponse, loginWithLocalAccount, fetchCurrentSession, and logoutCurrentSession. Calls POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me, and POST /api/auth/logout using the shared Axios client with interceptors. It must not store passwords, session ids, or fallback user data in frontend state.", "inputs": ["LoginRequest { username, password }", "HttpOnly cookie sent by browser for /auth/me and /auth/logout"], "outputs": ["SessionResponse { user }", "Rejected promise for 401 invalid credentials or anonymous session"], "callers": ["frontend/src/auth/AuthSessionProvider.tsx"], "callees": ["backend/src/auth/authRoutes.js mounted at /api/auth"], "test_focus": ["POST /auth/login is used for password login.", "GET /auth/me is available for session recovery.", "Invalid credentials propagate an error to the unified UI error path."]}

API-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-EXPRESS-ROUTES.content: {"interface_id": "API-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-EXPRESS-ROUTES", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "API", "name": "Express auth routes", "file_path": "backend/src/auth/authRoutes.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reuse backend HTTP endpoints for credential login, current-user loading, and logout with HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie session handling.", "specification": "Defines POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me, and POST /api/auth/logout. Login accepts anonymous credential exchange, calls sessionService.login, returns 401 with a generic invalid-credential response for any username/password failure, and sets arc_session as HttpOnly SameSite=Lax path=/ on success. GET /me denies anonymous or invalid sessions with 401 before returning user data. Logout uses requireAuth and clears the cookie. Allowed authenticated roles are STUDENT, SUPERVISOR, SCHOOL_ADMIN, and COLLEGE_ADMIN; no declared role is excluded.", "inputs": ["POST /api/auth/login body { username, password }", "Cookie header with arc_session for /me and /logout"], "outputs": ["200 { user } and Set-Cookie arc_session on valid credentials", "401 generic invalid-credential response without user-existence leakage", "401 anonymous response for missing/invalid current session", "204 logout response with cleared cookie"], "callers": ["frontend/src/api/authSession.ts", "backend/src/app.js"], "callees": ["backend/src/auth/sessionService.js", "backend/src/auth/authMiddleware.js"], "test_focus": ["Successful student01 login sets an HttpOnly arc_session cookie.", "Wrong password returns 401 and does not set a session cookie.", "Current-session endpoint enforces anonymous denial before user data is returned."]}

Repeated seeding is idempotent via UPSERT semantics. DB-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-REPOSITORY.content: {"interface_id": "DB-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-REPOSITORY", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "DB", "name": "Auth session repository", "file_path": "backend/src/auth/sessionRepository.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reuse persistence queries for auth users and sessions through the shared database runtime helpers.", "specification": "Provides findUserByUsername, findUserById, createSession, findSession, and deleteSession. DB-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-SCHEMA.content: {"interface_id": "DB-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-SCHEMA", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "DB", "name": "Auth users and sessions schema", "file_path": "backend/src/database/init_db.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reuse centralized SQLite schema creation for local users and persistent login sessions.", "specification": "Defines auth_users with unique username, bcrypt password_hash, role constrained to STUDENT/SUPERVISOR/SCHOOL_ADMIN/COLLEGE_ADMIN, college_id, supervisor_id, and scope. FUNC-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-AUTHZ-MIDDLEWARE.content: {"interface_id": "FUNC-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-AUTHZ-MIDDLEWARE", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "FUNC", "name": "Reusable auth authorization middleware", "file_path": "backend/src/auth/authMiddleware.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reuse the server-side authorization boundary for protected session actions and downstream role/data-scope enforcement.", "specification": "Provides parseCookies and requireAuth(options). Anonymous users are denied for protected boundaries such as logout and future business APIs before data is returned or state changes. Role enforcement accepts STUDENT, SUPERVISOR, SCHOOL_ADMIN, and COLLEGE_ADMIN for this permission-bearing leaf; no declared role is excluded. Data-scope enforcement is supplied by the serialized user fields and middleware options, not by frontend visibility alone.", "inputs": ["Cookie header", "allowedRoles option", "optional data-scope option"], "outputs": ["req.user for authorized users", "401 for anonymous/invalid session", "403 for disallowed role or data scope"], "callers": ["backend/src/auth/authRoutes.js logout route", "future protected business API route modules"], "callees": ["backend/src/auth/sessionService.js"], "test_focus": ["Anonymous protected requests are rejected server-side.", "Allowed role set covers STUDENT, SUPERVISOR, SCHOOL_ADMIN, and COLLEGE_ADMIN.", "Authorization is not implemented only by hiding frontend menu items."]}
callers: future protected business API route modules

FUNC-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-SERVICE.content: {"interface_id": "FUNC-FEAT-AUTH-SESSION-SERVICE", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "FUNC", "name": "Password verification and session service", "file_path": "backend/src/auth/sessionService.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reuse service logic for username lookup, bcrypt password verification, durable session creation/loading/expiration, logout deletion, and safe user serialization.", "specification": "login(username, password) looks up the user, performs bcrypt.compare against password_hash, returns null for missing user or password mismatch, creates an 8-hour session with crypto.randomUUID for valid credentials, and serializes only safe user fields: id, username, role, collegeId, supervisorId, and scope. loadSession rejects missing/expired sessions and deletes expired records. This is the core non-leaking password-auth boundary for FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD.", "inputs": ["username", "password", "sessionId"], "outputs": ["null for invalid credentials or invalid session", "{ sessionId, user } for valid login", "safe serialized user for valid session"], "callers": ["backend/src/auth/authRoutes.js", "backend/src/auth/authMiddleware.js"], "callees": ["backend/src/auth/sessionRepository.js", "bcrypt", "crypto"], "test_focus": ["Missing user and wrong password both return null.", "Valid student01 password creates a session and safe serialized user.", "Serialized user includes role and scope for role-aware home rendering."]}

UI-FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD-ROLE-AWARE-HOME-ME.content: {"interface_id": "UI-FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD-ROLE-AWARE-HOME-MENU", "req_id": "FEAT-AUTH-PASSWORD", "type": "UI", "name": "Role-aware authenticated home menu", "file_path": "frontend/src/auth/RoleAwareHomeMenu.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Render the authenticated user's role-specific home menu and data-scope summary using the shared global auth session state after local password login succeeds.", "specification": "Consumes useAuthSession from AuthSessionProvider. While session state is loading, renders an explicit loading state. When anonymous, renders an explicit login-required state rather than fake menu data. When authenticated, maps STUDENT to 学生菜单, SUPERVISOR to 导师菜单, SCHOOL_ADMIN to 学校管理菜单, and COLLEGE_ADMIN to 学院管理菜单, and displays data scope as 全校 for SCHOOL or 本学院 for COLLEGE. This component must not create page-local auth state or hardcoded user records; all role and scope data comes from the recovered/current session user.", "inputs": ["AuthSessionProvider context: status", "AuthSessionProvider context: user.role", "AuthSessionProvider context: user.scope"], "outputs": ["Loading/authenticated/anonymous home-menu UI", "Accessible section labelled 当前角色菜单 for authenticated users"], "callers": ["frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx"], "callees": ["frontend/src/auth/AuthSessionProvider.tsx"], "test_focus": ["After logging in as student01, '/' displays 学生菜单.", "Authenticated menu uses the provider user rather than local fallback records.", "Anonymous and loading states are explicit and do not present protected role data."]}

Login must call loginWithLocalAccount, store the returned user globally, and allow role-aware surfaces such as RoleAwareHomeMenu to render from the same state. RefreshSession must call /api/auth/me so HttpOnly-cookie-backed sessions survive navigation and refresh.", "inputs": ["LoginRequest from LocalAccountLoginForm", "HttpOnly cookie-backed current-session API response"], "outputs": ["Global AuthSessionContext", "AuthenticatedUser for role-aware UI", "Anonymous state on failed recovery"], "callers": ["frontend/src/main.tsx", "frontend/src/auth/LocalAccountLoginForm.tsx", "frontend/src/auth/RoleAwareHomeMenu.tsx"], "callees": ["frontend/src/api/authSession.ts"], "test_focus": ["Login updates global authenticated state.", "Session recovery loads user from /api/auth/me.", "Role-aware home content consumes the same provider state."]}
